summary: Blink Charging Co. filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, furnishing third-quarter 2026 results (Item 2.02) and updating fourth-quarter and full-year 2026 guidance via Exhibit 99.1. Separately, Item 8.01 discloses that on November 3, 2026 the Board appointed CEO Michael Battaglia as Chairman, succeeding Ritsaart van Montfrans, who becomes Lead Independent Director; Battaglia relinquishes the President title and receives no separate Chairman compensation, while the $30,000 supplemental retainer continues. The combined chair/CEO structure is presented as unified leadership with independent oversight preserved. No transaction terms, advisors, or deal mechanics are stated; this is a routine earnings and governance disclosure with no special-situation angle to trade.
